individual_systems.description: Evaluation metrics for each retrieval system, averaged over all queries

value_schema.ndcg@10: float, normalized discounted cumulative gain at cutoff 10
value_schema.map@10: float, mean average precision at cutoff 10

rrf.description: Best RRF configuration found via parameter search

combsum.description: Best CombSUM configuration found via weight search
combsum.best_weights: list of 3 floats, per-system weights in system_order

structure.best_method: string, name of method with highest nDCG@10 among all six
structure.best_ndcg: float, highest nDCG@10 value across all methods
structure.improvement_over_best_single: float, best_ndcg minus best individual system nDCG@10

significance_tests.description: Pairwise paired bootstrap significance tests between individual systems on nDCG@10
